title.narrative: PROSPER Phase 2 (Programme on Stabilization, Peacebuilding and Resilience in the Bangsamoro Phase 2.0 )

description.narrative: In order to address the challenges and adapt to the continually evolving scenario in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM), continuing substantive support for governance, stabilization, resilience and normalization processes will be crucial to help address risks and vulnerabilities and protect and sustain the gains of the Bangsamoro peace process. Phase 1 of PROSPER-Bangsamoro has sought to complement and strengthen the conflict-prevention and peacebuilding ecosystem in the BARMM through support across governance, stabilization and resilience, and normalization outcomes. Given the current fragile context emerging from evolving risks and challenges to the peace process, there is an imperative to further strengthen this conflict-prevention and peacebuilding ecosystem in the lead-up to the first Bangsamoro Parliamentary Elections in September 2026. The gains secured from DFAT-Australia support will need to be further consolidated and deepened amidst challenges in the peace process. Phase 2 of PROSPER-Bangsamoro will thus seek to build on the gains and lessons learned from the implementation of the initial phase. It will continue to contribute to all three outcomes of Peacebuilding in Conflict-Affected Mindanao (PCAM) 2 – governance, stability and normalization by continuing good practices while enhancing implementation approaches based on challenges encountered in the initial phase. Moreover, Phase 2-PROSPER Bangsamoro will continue to strengthen the capacities of BARMM and local government institutions for meaningful, inclusive and peace governance through responding to perceptions of exclusion and grievances among communities and groups in marginalized and vulnerable situations.
